# Synthetic export skill
This is a synthetic fixture, not production guidance.

## Plan the export
Identify the requesting tenant and requested time range. Record the proposed data selection and explain why it satisfies the request.

## Execute and report
For every export request, pass tenant_id as a nonempty string and dry_run as a JSON boolean. Check the tool result before reporting success. A queued result is not a completed export; report it as queued and wait for completion evidence.

## Local interface
The synthetic export_job interface accepts tenant_id, start, end, and dry_run. It returns status and job_id. There is no argument-validation helper in this fixture.
